## In short

- The query returns the members in declaration order.
- Each member has a name and an offset.

## What the query returns

Ask the compiler for the members of a type. It answers with a list in declaration order.

Each entry has a name. Use `identifier_of` to read it.

| Query | Result |
|---|---|
| names | the identifiers |
| offsets | byte positions |

The offsets include padding, so the sum of the sizes can be smaller than the type.
